goal: Prepare a locally and remotely validated PEFT/LoRA adapter path for BGE-M3 M3 distillation after v69a showed that tiny full-encoder movement did not pass the standalone-student gate.

fresh_sources_checked.implication: BGE-M3 is explicitly dense+sparse+multi-vector, and the model card recommends hybrid retrieval plus reranking; adapter work must preserve hybrid scoring surfaces.
The paper motivates multi-function self-knowledge distillation, so adapter training should stay on the M3 unified objective rather than dense-only loss.
Official M3 training exposes dense, sparse, and ColBERT modes under unified_finetuning and m3_kd_loss.
Teacher-score JSONL with pos_scores and neg_scores remains the compatible training interface.
PEFT LoRA supports explicit target_modules; q/value attention adapters are a conservative first adapter surface, while all-linear is a larger QLoRA-style option.

capabilities: LoRA target preset resolution for attention_qv, attention_qkv, and all_linear.
Linear module discovery and LoRA trainable-parameter estimation without importing torch or peft at module import time.
Optional --lora-enable path in the no-DDP FlagEmbedding M3 wrapper that monkeypatches EncoderOnlyEmbedderM3Runner.get_model and wraps the returned encoder with PEFT.
Compatibility shim for PEFT versions that probe torch.distributed.tensor.DTensor when the installed torch.distributed module does not expose tensor.

decision.recommended_first_training_smoke: v70a attention_qv LoRA rank16/alpha32/dropout0.05 over the v69 blended teacher rows, official M3 no-DDP m3_kd_loss, fix_encoder=False, unified_finetuning=True, 128 rows, group size 5, batch size 1, gradient accumulation 8, lr no higher than 5e-5 for the first adapter-only smoke, same fixed 200-query diagnostic gate.
decision.why_attention_qv_first: It is the smallest validated adapter surface: 48 modules and 1.57M trainable parameters, versus 2.36M for qkv and 7.08M for all-linear.
decision.gate: Do not full-dev evaluate, upload, publish, or call SOTA unless the adapter checkpoint beats frozen BGE-M3 by at least +0.005 nDCG@10 on both best-vs-best and model-card same-candidate diagnostics.
